title: populus × serotina var. erecta
intro: Populus × serotina var. erecta, commonly known as Black Cottonwood, is a hybrid tree species that is native to North America. The health benefits of Black Cottonwood include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, as well as its ability to stimulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Black Cottonwood include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
